1482    def start_head_tracking(self):
1483        self.refresh_hardware_tracking_status(show_message=False)
1484
1485        # if rotation tracker is running, stop it first before startin again
1486        if self.rotation_tracker.is_running():
1487            # make sure we don't forget the current tracking mode
1488            tracking_mode = self.tracking_mode.get()
1489            self.stop_head_tracking()
1490            self.tracking_mode.set(tracking_mode)
1491
1492        match self.tracking_mode.get():
1493            case "Demo":
1494                self.rotation_tracker = self.demo_tracker
1495                self.set_sliders_state(False)
1496            case "Hardware":
1497                if "Hardware" not in self.get_tracking_modes():
1498                    self.tracking_status.set("Tracking: Hardware unavailable")
1499                    messagebox.showwarning(
1500                        "Head Tracking",
1501                        "No supported hardware tracker is available. Use Demo tracking instead.",
1502                    )
1503                    return
1504                try:
1505                    self.rotation_tracker = self.head_tracker
1506                    self.set_sliders_state(False)
1507                except Exception as e:
1508                    print(f"Something went wrong: {e}")
1509            case "Off":
1510                self.set_sliders_state(True)
1511                return
1512
1513        try:
1514            if self.tracking_mode.get() == "Hardware":
1515                self.rotation_tracker.start(chirality=self.chirality.get())
1516                self.zero_tracker_button["state"] = "normal"
1517            else:
1518                self.rotation_tracker.start()
1519            self.start_stop_tracking_button["text"] = "Stop Tracking"
1520
1521
1522        except Exception as error:
1523            self.tracking_status.set("Tracking: failed to start")
1524            print(f"[Head Tracking Error] {error}")
1525            traceback.print_exc()
1526            messagebox.showerror("Head Tracking Error", str(error))
1527            return
1528
1529        self.tracking_status.set(self.tracking_mode.get() + " headtracking is running")
1530        self.playback_status.set("Status: " + self.tracking_mode.get() + " tracking")
1531
1532    def stop_head_tracking(self, reset_orientation=True):
1533        self.rotation_tracker.stop()
1534        self.start_stop_tracking_button["text"] = "Start Tracking"
1535        self.start_stop_tracking_button["state"] = "enabled"
1536        self.zero_tracker_button["state"] = "disabled"
1537        self.chirality_box["state"] = "disabled"
1538        self.tracking_status.set("Head tracking is off")
1539        self.set_sliders_state(True)
1540
1541        match self.tracking_mode.get():
1542            case "Demo":
1543                self.rotation_tracker = self.demo_tracker
1544            case "Hardware":
1545                self.rotation_tracker = self.head_tracker
1546                self.chirality_box["state"] = "readonly"
1547            case "Off":
1548                self.start_stop_tracking_button.state(["disabled"])
1549                #print(self.tracking_mode.get())
1550
1551        if reset_orientation:
1552            orientation = self.orientation_state.set(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, source="off")
1553            self.yaw_value.set(0.0)
1554            self.pitch_value.set(0.0)
1555            self.roll_value.set(0.0)
1556            self.update_rotation_label()
1557            self.draw_head_tracking_visualizer(orientation)
1558            if self.has_loaded_player():
1559                self.apply_orientation_to_audio(orientation)
1560
1561    def update_head_tracking_loop(self):
1562        if self.rotation_tracker.is_running():
1563            orientation = self.rotation_tracker.orientation_state.get()
1564
1565            # Build kwargs for the fields that need zeroing
1566            updates = {}
1567            if not self.yaw_check_val.get():
1568                updates['yaw'] = 0.0
1569            if not self.pitch_check_val.get():
1570                updates['pitch'] = 0.0
1571            if not self.roll_check_val.get():
1572                updates['roll'] = 0.0
1573            
1574            # replace orientation if update is needed
1575            if updates:
1576                orientation = replace(orientation, **updates)
1577
1578            # push audio updates as fast as possible before doing anything else
1579            self.apply_orientation_to_audio(orientation)
1580
1581            # set slider values
1582            self.yaw_value.set(orientation.yaw)
1583            self.pitch_value.set(orientation.pitch)
1584            self.roll_value.set(orientation.roll)
1585
1586            self.update_rotation_label()
1587            self.draw_head_tracking_visualizer(orientation)
1588        # 10 ms refresh rate allows to get all the orientation data even when the head tracker works at maximum rate (100 Hz)
1589        self.root.after(10, self.update_head_tracking_loop)
1590
1591    def draw_head_tracking_visualizer(self, orientation):
1592        ypr = [orientation.yaw, orientation.pitch, orientation.roll]
1593        self._visualizer.draw(rotation=ypr)

1655    def update_gui_loop(self):
1656        if self.has_loaded_player():
1657            current_time = self.player.get_current_time()
1658            duration = self.player.get_duration()
1659
1660            if not self.is_dragging_progress:
1661                self.progress_value.set(current_time)
1662                self.time_text.set(
1663                    f"{self.format_time(current_time)} / {self.format_time(duration)}"
1664                )
1665
1666            self.refresh_playback_status()
1667          
1668
1669        self.root.after(250, self.update_gui_loop)
1670
1671    @staticmethod
1672    def format_time(seconds: float):
1673        minutes = int(seconds // 60)
1674        secs = seconds % 60
1675        return f"{minutes:02d}:{secs:05.2f}"
1676
1677    def refresh_playback_status(self):
1678        if not self.has_loaded_player() or self.is_loading:
1679            return
1680
1681        if self.player.pause_event.is_set():
1682            self.playback_status.set("Status: Paused")
1683        elif self.player.play_event.is_set() and not self.player.stop_event.is_set():
1684            self.playback_status.set("Status: Playing")
1685
1686    # ==============================================================
1687    # Lifecycle
1688    # ==============================================================
1689
1690    def on_close(self):
1691        self.stop_head_tracking(reset_orientation=False)
1692        if self.has_player():
1693            try:
1694                self.player.close()
1695            except Exception:
1696                print("Player didn't close cleanly!")
1697                pass
1698        self.emtpy_and_close_cache()
1699        self.root.destroy()
1700
1701    def emtpy_and_close_cache(self):
1702        """
1703        Empties and closes all cached SH objects
1704        """
1705        for hrtf, sh in self._decoder_cache.values():
1706            sh.close()
1707
1708    def run(self):
1709        self.root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_close)
1710        self.root.mainloop()

GUI for the Ambisonics Player.

Main supported workflow: AmbiX WAV -> AmbisonicsFile -> HRTF/SphericalHarmonics -> AudioPlayer

The old standalone binaural WAV path is intentionally disabled in this GUI because the current AudioPlayer backend is an AmbiX streaming player.

def on_mousewheel(self, event): 
224    def on_mousewheel(self, event):
225        # Only scroll the canvas when the mouse is over the scrollable page area.
226        # Combobox dropdowns, dialog popups etc. are NOT children of scroll_frame.
227        if not self._is_inside_scroll_frame(event):
228            return
229
230        # Close any open dropdowns so they don't get left behind when the page moves.
231        self.root.event_generate("<Escape>")
232
233        # Skip events that land on the info text widget (it handles its own scroll).
234        if event.widget is getattr(self, "info_text", None):
235            return
236
237        if getattr(event, "num", None) == 4:
238            self.scroll_canvas.yview_scroll(-1, "units")
239        elif getattr(event, "num", None) == 5:
240            self.scroll_canvas.yview_scroll(1, "units")
241        else:
242            self.scroll_canvas.yview_scroll(int(-1 * (event.delta / 120)), "units")

def get_tracking_modes(self): 
602    def get_tracking_modes(self):
603        modes = ["Off"]

def load_ambix(self): 
860    def load_ambix(self):
861        if self.is_loading:
862            return
863
864        file_path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
865            title="Select AmbiX / Ambisonics WAV file",
866            filetypes=[("Ambisonics WAV files", "*.wav"), ("All files", "*.*")],
867        )
868
869        if not file_path:
870            return
871
872        if self.has_player():
873            try:
874                self.player.stop()
875            except Exception as e:
876                print(e)
877                pass
878        #self.stop_head_tracking(reset_orientation=False)
879
880        file_name = os.path.basename(file_path)
881        self.selected_file.set(f"AmbiX file selected: {file_name}")
882        self.input_type.set("Input type: AmbiX / multichannel WAV")
883        self.output_type.set("Output: preparing binaural stream")
884        self.pipeline_status.set("Pipeline: loading AmbiX and preparing decoder")
885        self.playback_status.set("Status: Loading")
886        self.playback_status_label.configure(foreground="red")
887        self.write_info_text(self.build_info_text())
888
889        order = self.get_order()
890        block_size = self.get_block_size()
891        gain = float(self.volume_value.get())
892        headphone_name = self.headphone_value.get()
893        hp_samples = self.hp_sample_value.get()
894        hrtf_path = self.get_selected_hrtf_path()
895        app_dir = str(self.app_dir)
896
897        self.set_loading(True, "Loading AmbiX and preprocessing HRTF. Controls are disabled.")
898
899        def worker(path, requested_order, requested_block_size, requested_gain, hrtf_file, headphone, requested_hp_samples, cwd):
900            old_cwd = os.getcwd()
901            try:
902                os.chdir(cwd)
903
904                ambix = AmbisonicsFile(
905                    path,
906                    chunk_size=requested_block_size,
907                    order=requested_order,
908                    trim_extra_channels=True,
909                    format="ambix",
910                    normalization="SN3D",
911                )
912                if not ambix.is_valid():
913                    raise ValueError(
914                        "Selected file is not valid for the selected Ambisonics order."
915                    )
916
917                normalized_hp = None if headphone in (None, "", "None") else headphone
918                normalized_hrtf = self._normalize_hrtf_path(hrtf_file)
919                cache_key = (normalized_hrtf, normalized_hp, ambix.get_order(), requested_hp_samples)
920                if cache_key in self._decoder_cache:
921                    hrtf, sh = self._decoder_cache[cache_key]
922                    # restart the rotation on loading a cached SH
923                    sh.restart_rotation()
924                    print("Decoder settings unchanged — reusing cached HRTF and SH coefficients.")
925                else:
926                    hrtf = HRTF(hrtf_file)
927                    if headphone != "None":
928                        hrtf.load_hp_filter(headphone, requested_hp_samples)
929                    sh = SphericalHarmonics(
930                        hrtf=hrtf,
931                        sampling_rate=ambix.get_samplerate(),
932                        ambi_order=ambix.get_order(),
933                        block_size=ambix.get_chunk_size()
934                    )
935                    self._decoder_cache[cache_key] = (hrtf, sh)
936                    print("Decoder settings changed — building HRTF and SH coefficients.")
937
938                player = AudioPlayer(ambi_file=ambix, sh=sh, gain=requested_gain)
939                player.source_name = path
940                player.set_loaded(True)
941
942                result = {
943                    "player": player,
944                    "path": path,
945                    "order": ambix.get_order(),
946                    "channels": ambix.get_num_channels(),
947                    "sample_rate": ambix.get_samplerate(),
948                    "duration": ambix.get_duration(),
949                    "headphone": headphone,
950                    "hrtf": hrtf_file,
951                }
952                self._backend_load_queue.put(("new_load", result))
953            except Exception as error:
954                traceback.print_exc()
955                self._backend_load_queue.put(("error", str(error)))
956                try:
957                    if 'sh' in locals():
958                        sh.close()
959                except Exception as e:
960                    traceback.print_exc()
961            finally:
962                os.chdir(old_cwd)
963
964        threading.Thread(
965            target=worker,
966            args=(file_path, order, block_size, gain, hrtf_path, headphone_name, hp_samples, app_dir),
967            daemon=True,
968        ).start()
def update_decoder_settings(self): 
 970    def update_decoder_settings(self):
 971
 972        # try to find any changes to the decoder settings. if so, update all necessary attributes in player.
 973        # get current values
 974        requested_order = self.get_order()
 975        requested_block_size = self.get_block_size()
 976        requested_hp = self.headphone_value.get()
 977        requested_hp_samples = self.hp_sample_value.get()
 978        requested_hrtf = self.get_selected_hrtf_path()
 979
 980        if requested_hp in (None, "", "None"):
 981            requested_hp = None
 982
 983        # lock decoder settings and playback buttons
 984        # put a text that informs the user why everything is disabled
 985        self.set_loading(True, "Processing new decoder values. Controls are disabled.")
 986
 987        self.update_event.clear()
 988
 989        # the worker thread setting up all new variables
 990        def update_decoder(new_hrtf=None, new_hp=None, new_hp_samples=None, new_block_size=None, new_order=None):
 991            try: 
 992                player = self.player
 993                if player is None:
 994                    raise RuntimeError("No player loaded.")
 995                
 996                current_hrtf = self._normalize_hrtf_path(getattr(player.sh.hrtf, "path", None))
 997                current_hp = getattr(player.sh.hrtf, "current_filter", None)
 998                current_hp_samples = player.sh.hrtf.hrirs.n_samples
 999                current_block_size = player.ambi_file.get_chunk_size()
1000                current_order = player.ambi_file.get_order()
1001                
1002                new_hrtf = self._normalize_hrtf_path(new_hrtf)
1003                if new_hp in (None, "", "None"):
1004                    new_hp = None
1005
1006                change = False
1007                needs_rebuild = False
1008                order_warning = None
1009                build_hp = False
1010
1011                hp = current_hp
1012                hp_samples = current_hp_samples
1013
1014                if new_hrtf is not None and new_hrtf != current_hrtf:
1015                    print("Updating HRTF")
1016                    # hrtf file changed
1017                    player.sh.hrtf = HRTF(new_hrtf)
1018                    change = True
1019                    needs_rebuild = True
1020
1021                if new_hp != current_hp:
1022                    print("Updating HP Filter")
1023                    # calculate new hp_filter
1024                    hp = new_hp
1025                    change = True
1026                    needs_rebuild = True
1027                    build_hp = True
1028
1029                if new_hp_samples != current_hp_samples:
1030                    print("Updating HP Filter Sample Size")
1031                    hp_samples = new_hp_samples
1032                    change = True
1033                    needs_rebuild = True
1034                    build_hp = True
1035
1036                if build_hp:
1037                    # calculate new hp_filter
1038                    self.player.sh.hrtf.load_hp_filter(hp, hp_samples)
1039
1040                if new_block_size is not None and new_block_size != current_block_size:
1041                    print("Updating Buffer Size")
1042                    # block size changed
1043                    # update block size in ambi_file. player gets the updates automatically
1044                    self.player.ambi_file.set_chunk_size(new_block_size)
1045                    change = True
1046
1047                if new_order is not None and new_order != current_order:
1048                    print("Updating Order")
1049                    # order changed
1050                    # set order in ambi file (may be silently clamped)
1051                    self.player.ambi_file.set_order(new_order)
1052                    actual_order = self.player.ambi_file.get_order()
1053                    if actual_order < new_order:
1054                        order_warning = (
1055                            f"Requested order {new_order} exceeds what this file supports "
1056                            f"(max order {actual_order}). Using order {actual_order} instead."
1057                        )
1058                    else:
1059                        order_warning = None
1060                    change = True
1061                    needs_rebuild = True
1062
1063                if needs_rebuild:
1064                    # check cache before rebuilding
1065                    rebuild_order = player.ambi_file.get_order()
1066                    rebuild_hrtf = new_hrtf if new_hrtf is not None else current_hrtf
1067                    rebuild_key = (rebuild_hrtf, hp, rebuild_order, hp_samples)
1068
1069                    if rebuild_key in self._decoder_cache:
1070                        _, new_sh = self._decoder_cache[rebuild_key]
1071                        print(f"Reusing cached SH for order {rebuild_order}.")
1072                    else:
1073                        new_sh = SphericalHarmonics(
1074                            hrtf=player.sh.hrtf,
1075                            sampling_rate=player.ambi_file.get_samplerate(),
1076                            ambi_order=rebuild_order,
1077                        )
1078                        self._decoder_cache[rebuild_key] = (player.sh.hrtf, new_sh)
1079                        print(f"Built and cached order {rebuild_order}.")
1080
1081                    # cleanup old SH instance
1082                    player.sh.close()
1083                    # restart the rotation on loading a cached SH
1084                    new_sh.restart_rotation()
1085                    player.sh = new_sh
1086
1087                    # Stop audio stream so Play works after decoder rebuild
1088                    player.stop()
1089                    # player.play_event.clear()
1090                    # if player.stream is not None:
1091                    #     player.stream.stop()
1092                    #     player.stream.close()
1093                    #     player.stream = None
1094
1095                    # Update decoder cache with rebuilt HRTF+SH
1096                    cached_hrtf_path = new_hrtf if new_hrtf is not None else current_hrtf
1097                    cached_hp = new_hp if new_hp is not None else current_hp
1098                    cache_key = (cached_hrtf_path, cached_hp, player.ambi_file.get_order(), hp_samples)
1099                    self._decoder_cache[cache_key] = (player.sh.hrtf, new_sh)
1100
1101                if change:
1102                    player.update_process_variables()
1103
1104                result = {
1105                    "order": player.ambi_file.get_order(),
1106                    "channels": player.ambi_file.get_num_channels(),
1107                    "sample_rate": player.ambi_file.get_samplerate(),
1108                    "duration": player.ambi_file.get_duration(),
1109                    "headphone": new_hp if new_hp is not None else current_hp,
1110                    "hrtf": new_hrtf if new_hrtf is not None else current_hrtf,
1111                    "order_warning": order_warning,
1112                }
1113                self._backend_load_queue.put(("decoder_update", result))
1114
1115            except Exception as error:
1116                traceback.print_exc()
1117                self._backend_load_queue.put(("decoder_update_error", str(error)))
1118            finally:
1119                self.update_event.set()
1120
1121        # starting worker thread
1122        threading.Thread(
1123            target=update_decoder,
1124            args=(requested_hrtf, requested_hp, requested_hp_samples, requested_block_size, requested_order),
1125            daemon=True,
1126        ).start()

1240            self._handle_error("Error", error)

1486        if self.rotation_tracker.is_running():
1487            # make sure we don't forget the current tracking mode
1488            tracking_mode = self.tracking_mode.get()
1489            self.stop_head_tracking()
1490            self.tracking_mode.set(tracking_mode)
1491
1492        match self.tracking_mode.get():
1493            case "Demo":
1494                self.rotation_tracker = self.demo_tracker
1495                self.set_sliders_state(False)
1496            case "Hardware":
1497                if "Hardware" not in self.get_tracking_modes():
1498                    self.tracking_status.set("Tracking: Hardware unavailable")
1499                    messagebox.showwarning(
1500                        "Head Tracking",
1501                        "No supported hardware tracker is available. Use Demo tracking instead.",
1502                    )
1503                    return
1504                try:
1505                    self.rotation_tracker = self.head_tracker
1506                    self.set_sliders_state(False)
1507                except Exception as e:
1508                    print(f"Something went wrong: {e}")
1509            case "Off":
1510                self.set_sliders_state(True)
1511                return
1512
1513        try:
1514            if self.tracking_mode.get() == "Hardware":
1515                self.rotation_tracker.start(chirality=self.chirality.get())
1516                self.zero_tracker_button["state"] = "normal"
1517            else:
1518                self.rotation_tracker.start()
1519            self.start_stop_tracking_button["text"] = "Stop Tracking"
1520
1521
1522        except Exception as error:
1523            self.tracking_status.set("Tracking: failed to start")
1524            print(f"[Head Tracking Error] {error}")
1525            traceback.print_exc()
1526            messagebox.showerror("Head Tracking Error", str(error))
1527            return
1528
1529        self.tracking_status.set(self.tracking_mode.get() + " headtracking is running")
1530        self.playback_status.set("Status: " + self.tracking_mode.get() + " tracking")

1562        if self.rotation_tracker.is_running():

1564
1565            # Build kwargs for the fields that need zeroing
1566            updates = {}
1567            if not self.yaw_check_val.get():

1569            if not self.pitch_check_val.get():
1570                updates['pitch'] = 0.0
1571            if not self.roll_check_val.get():
1572                updates['roll'] = 0.0
1573            
1574            # replace orientation if update is needed
1575            if updates:
1576                orientation = replace(orientation, **updates)
1577
1578            # push audio updates as fast as possible before doing anything else
1579            self.apply_orientation_to_audio(orientation)
1580
1581            # set slider values
1582            self.yaw_value.set(orientation.yaw)
1583            self.pitch_value.set(orientation.pitch)
1584            self.roll_value.set(orientation.roll)
1585
1586            self.update_rotation_label()
1587            self.draw_head_tracking_visualizer(orientation)
1588        # 10 ms refresh rate allows to get all the orientation data even when the head tracker works at maximum rate (100 Hz)

class Visual3D: 
 21class Visual3D:
 22    """ A drawable `.obj` mesh representation for Tk canvas rendering. """
 23    # .obj format specifications
 24    VERTEX, FACE = 'v', 'f'
 25    RELEVANTS = [relevant + ' ' for relevant in (VERTEX, FACE)]
 26
 27    def __init__(self, filename, canvas, scale=500, position=[]*2,
 28                 rotation=None, zoom=10, line_colour='#0000FF', point_size=2,
 29                 point_colour='#FFFFFF'):
 30        """
 31        Create a new Visual3D instance.
 32        
 33        Parameters
 34        ----------
 35        filename : str
 36            The path to the `.obj` file.
 37        canvas : tk.Canvas
 38            The tkinter canvas to draw the 3D object on.
 39        scale : int, optional
 40            The scaling factor.
 41        position, optional : list of int
 42            Horizontal and vertical offsets to move the object across the canvas.
 43        rotation, optional : list of int
 44            Rotation values around the fixed-world axes X, Y and Z.
 45        zoom, optional : int
 46            Zooming factor.
 47        line_colour : 
 48        """
 49
 50        self._read_points(filename)
 51        self._init_display(canvas, scale, position, rotation, zoom,
 52                           line_colour, point_size, point_colour)
 53
 54    def _read_points(self, filename):
 55        """ Parse a `.obj` file to extract the relevant data. """
 56        # initialise variables
 57        self.long_filename = self.filename = filename
 58        if '/' in filename:
 59            self.filename = self.filename[self.filename.rfind('/')+1:]
 60        elif '\\' in filename:
 61            self.filename = self.filename[self.filename.rfind('\\')+1:]
 62
 63        self._faces    = []
 64        vertices       = []
 65
 66        # populate from file
 67        with open(resolve_path(filename)) as file:
 68            for line in file:
 69                # use a generator to stop checking line early if possible
 70                if all(not line.startswith(relevant)
 71                       for relevant in self.RELEVANTS):
 72                    continue # ignore all lines that aren't relevant
 73                data = line.split()
 74                line_type = data[0]
 75                data = data[1:]
 76                if line_type == self.VERTEX:
 77                    vertices.append([float(x) for x in data])
 78                elif line_type == self.FACE:
 79                    # -1 to switch from .obj indices to 0-based indices
 80                    self._faces.append([int(f.split('/')[0])-1 for f in data])
 81            self._vertices = np.array(vertices).T
 82
 83    def _init_display(self, canvas, scale, position, rotation, zoom,
 84                      line_colour, point_size, point_colour):
 85        """ Initialise the display and draw the object. """
 86        self._position = np.array(position) if position else np.array([420, 540])#[0]*2)
 87        self._rotation = np.array(rotation) if rotation else np.array([0.]*3)
 88        self._scale    = scale if scale else 2500 # TODO scale to canvas?
 89        self._zoom     = zoom if zoom else 20
 90
 91        self._canvas       = canvas
 92        self._line_colour  = line_colour
 93        self._point_size   = point_size
 94        self._point_colour = point_colour
 95
 96        self._changed = True
 97        self._polygon_ids = []
 98        self.draw(rotation=self._rotation)
 99
100    def draw(self, zoom=None, rotation=None, spin=False):
101        """ Draw self, zoomed and rotated. """
102        # update only if changed since last time
103        delta = np.max(np.abs(np.array(rotation) - self._rotation))
104        if zoom is not None and zoom != self._zoom:
105            self._zoom = zoom
106            self._changed = True
107        if spin:
108            if rotation is not None:
109                self._rotation += rotation
110            else:
111                self._rotation *= 2
112            self._changed = True
113        elif rotation is not None and delta>0.2: # 0.2 degree threshold on any axis
114            self._rotation = np.radians(rotation)
115            self._changed = True
116        if not self._changed:
117            return # change below the threshold, so no need to re-draw
118
119        # only calculate this once, since it's the same for all points
120        rotation = self._rotation_matrix()
121        C = np.array([
122            [0, -1, 0],
123            [0,  0, 1],
124            [1,  0, 0]
125        ])
126        rotation = C @ rotation @ C.T
127        # vectorised matrix arithmetic - do all points at once
128        rotated = rotation @ self._vertices
129        point_scales = self._scale / (self._zoom - rotated[2])
130
131        self._projected_points = (rotated[:2] * [[1],[-1]] * point_scales).T \
132                                + self._position
133        
134        if not self._polygon_ids:
135            self._create_faces()
136        else:
137            self._update_faces()
138
139        self._changed = False
140
141    def _rotation_matrix(self):
142        """ Returns the current net rotation matrix for self. """
143        yaw, pitch, roll = self._rotation
144        # match the sign convention of the visualiser
145        yaw = -yaw
146
147        cos = Angle(np.cos(roll), np.cos(pitch), np.cos(yaw))
148        sin = Angle(np.sin(roll), np.sin(pitch), np.sin(yaw))
149
150        rot_x = np.array([[1, 0    , 0     ],
151                            [0, cos.x, -sin.x],
152                            [0, sin.x, cos.x ]])
153
154        rot_y = np.array([[cos.y, 0, -sin.y],
155                            [0    , 1, 0     ],
156                            [sin.y, 0, cos.y ]])
157
158        rot_z = np.array([[cos.z, -sin.z, 0],
159                            [sin.z, cos.z , 0],
160                            [0    , 0     , 1]])
161        return rot_z @ rot_y @ rot_x
162
163    def _draw_projected_points(self):
164        """ Draw the current projected points. """
165        for point in self._projected_points:
166            self._canvas.create_line(*point, *point, width=self._point_size,
167                                     fill=self._point_colour)
168
169    def _draw_faces(self):
170        """ Draw the lines for each stored face. Superseded by _create_faces() and _update_faces()"""
171        for face in self._faces:
172            draw_points = []
173            for point_index in face:
174                draw_points.extend(self._projected_points[point_index])
175            self._canvas.create_polygon(draw_points, outline=self._line_colour,
176                                        fill='')
177    
178    def _create_faces(self):
179        """Draw the complete object from scratch. Only runs once upon creating the instance"""
180        self._polygon_ids = []
181        for face in self._faces:
182            draw_points = []
183            for point_index in face:
184                draw_points.extend(self._projected_points[point_index])
185            polygon = self._canvas.create_polygon(
186                draw_points, outline=self._line_colour, fill="")
187            self._polygon_ids.append(polygon)
188            
189    def _update_faces(self):
190        """Update polygon coordinates to refresh the canvas"""
191        for polygon_id, face in zip(self._polygon_ids, self._faces):
192            draw_points = []
193            for point_index in face:
194                draw_points.extend(self._projected_points[point_index])
195            self._canvas.coords(
196                polygon_id,
197                *draw_points
198            )
199
200    def move(self, direction, amount):
201        """Two-dimentional translation of the object"""
202        directions = {
203            '<Up>'   : (1, -1),
204            '<Down>' : (1, 1),
205            '<Left>' : (0, -1),
206            '<Right>': (0, 1)
207        }
208        index, sign = directions[direction]
209        self._position[index] += sign * amount
210        self._changed = True
211
212    def reset_rotation(self):
213        """Reset rotation to (0, 0, 0)"""
214        self._rotation = np.array([0]*3)
215
216    @classmethod
217    def from_file(cls, canvas, filename='', *args, **kwargs):
218        if not filename:
219            filename = filedialog.askopenfilename(defaultextension='.obj',
220                    filetypes=(('OBJ Files', '*.obj'),
221                               ('All Files', '*.*')))
222            extension = filename[filename.rfind('.'):]
223            if extension != '.obj':
224                message = f'Invalid format {extension} - only .obj files allowed.'
225                messagebox.showinfo(message=message, title="ERROR")
226        return cls(filename, canvas, *args, **kwargs)

A drawable .obj mesh representation for Tk canvas rendering.

28                 rotation=None, zoom=10, line_colour='#0000FF', point_size=2,
29                 point_colour='#FFFFFF'):
30        """
31        Create a new Visual3D instance.
32        
33        Parameters
34        ----------
35        filename : str
36            The path to the `.obj` file.
37        canvas : tk.Canvas

def draw(self, zoom=None, rotation=None, spin=False): 
100    def draw(self, zoom=None, rotation=None, spin=False):
101        """ Draw self, zoomed and rotated. """
102        # update only if changed since last time
103        delta = np.max(np.abs(np.array(rotation) - self._rotation))
104        if zoom is not None and zoom != self._zoom:
105            self._zoom = zoom
106            self._changed = True
107        if spin:
108            if rotation is not None:
109                self._rotation += rotation
110            else:
111                self._rotation *= 2
112            self._changed = True
113        elif rotation is not None and delta>0.2: # 0.2 degree threshold on any axis
114            self._rotation = np.radians(rotation)
115            self._changed = True
116        if not self._changed:
117            return # change below the threshold, so no need to re-draw
118
119        # only calculate this once, since it's the same for all points
120        rotation = self._rotation_matrix()
121        C = np.array([
122            [0, -1, 0],
123            [0,  0, 1],
124            [1,  0, 0]
125        ])
126        rotation = C @ rotation @ C.T
127        # vectorised matrix arithmetic - do all points at once
128        rotated = rotation @ self._vertices
129        point_scales = self._scale / (self._zoom - rotated[2])
130
131        self._projected_points = (rotated[:2] * [[1],[-1]] * point_scales).T \
132                                + self._position
133        
134        if not self._polygon_ids:
135            self._create_faces()
136        else:
137            self._update_faces()
138
139        self._changed = False

202        directions = {

204            '<Down>' : (1, 1),
205            '<Left>' : (0, -1),
206            '<Right>': (0, 1)
207        }
208        index, sign = directions[direction]
209        self._position[index] += sign * amount
210        self._changed = True

def ambix_channels_to_order(num_channels: int) -> int: 
38def ambix_channels_to_order(num_channels: int) -> int:
39    """
40    Return the ambisonics order corresponding to the number of given channels.
41
42    For a given ambisonic order N the number of channels is (N + 1)^2.
43
44    Parameters
45    --------------
46    num_channels : int
47        Channel count to find ambisonics order for.
48
49    Returns
50    -------
51    int
52    """
53    if num_channels < 1:
54        raise ValueError(
55            f"Channel count {num_channels} is too low for Ambisonics. "
56            f"Minimum required: 1 channel (order 0)."
57        )
58
59    # Find the largest order where (order+1)^2 <= num_channels
60    order = int(np.sqrt(num_channels)) - 1
61
62    if order > 7:
63        raise ValueError(
64            f"Channel count {num_channels} would require order {order}, "
65            f"but maximum supported order is 7 (64 channels)."
66        )
67
68    logger.debug(
69        "Detected Ambisonics order %d from %d channels (min %d)",
70        order, num_channels, (order + 1) ** 2,
71    )
72    return order

74def next_power_of_two(n: int) -> int:

82

85    int

87    """
88    # make use of bitshifts to quickly calculate the enxt power of two
89    return 1 << (n - 1).bit_length()

def resolve_path(path): 
12def resolve_path(path):
13        if path is None:
14            return None
15
16        try:
17            candidate = Path(path)
18        except TypeError as error:
19            print(f"Couldn't parse path: {path}. {error}")
20            return None
21
22        if candidate.is_absolute():
23            return candidate
24        
25        # try to locate from program root
26        root_candidate = _PROJECT_ROOT / candidate
27        if root_candidate.exists():
28            return root_candidate
29
30        # try to locate relative to utils.py
31        local_candidate = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / candidate
32        if local_candidate.exists():
33            return local_candidate
34
35        # couldn't resolve
36        return candidate

__version__ = '0.1.0'
def render_to_binaural_file( ambi_file: AmbisonicsFile, sh: SphericalHarmonics, out_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, gain: float = 1.0, subtype: str = 'FLOAT', progress_callback: Callable[[int, int], NoneType] | None = None) -> int: 
 96def render_to_binaural_file(
 97    ambi_file: AmbisonicsFile,
 98    sh: SphericalHarmonics,
 99    out_path: Union[str, Path],
100    *,
101    gain: float = 1.0,
102    subtype: str = "FLOAT",
103    progress_callback: Optional[Callable[[int, int], None]] = None,
104) -> int:
105    """
106    Decode an entire AmbiX file to a binaural stereo WAV, streamed in chunks.
107
108    Memory usage is O(chunk): one FFT buffer plus one (M-1, 2) overlap
109    buffer, independent of file length.  Output length equals
110    ``total_frames + sh.get_IR_length() - 1``, matching a full-file
111    ``mode='full'`` convolution (``SphericalHarmonics.apply_hrtf``).
112
113    Parameters
114    ----------
115    ambi_file : AmbisonicsFile
116        Input file.  Its chunk size drives the streaming block length.  The
117        read position is saved on entry and restored on exit.
118    sh : SphericalHarmonics
119        Decoder whose channel count must match the file.  Rendering uses the
120        decoder's *current* rotation state; equivalence with ``apply_hrtf``
121        (which ignores rotation) holds only for identity rotation.
122    out_path : str or Path
123        Output WAV path.  Overwritten if it exists.
124    gain : float, optional
125        Post-decode gain in ``[0., 1.]``, applied per block.  Default 1.0.
126    subtype : str, optional
127        libsndfile subtype for the output.  Default ``"FLOAT"`` (32-bit
128        float) to preserve decode precision; note plain ``soundfile.write``
129        would default to ``"PCM_16"`` for WAV.
130    progress_callback : callable, optional
131        Called once per chunk as ``progress_callback(frames_read,
132        total_frames)``.
133
134    Returns
135    -------
136    int
137        Number of stereo frames written (0 for an empty input file).
138
139    Raises
140    ------
141    ValueError
142        If the file channel count does not match the decoder.
143    AttributeError
144        If ``gain`` is outside ``[0., 1.]``.
145    """
146    # validate before opening the output file so failures leave no artifact
147    # (checks mirror AudioPlayer.__init__)
148    _, sh_channels, _ = sh.hrir_nm.shape
149    if ambi_file.get_num_channels() != sh_channels:
150        raise ValueError("Channel counts must match (e.g. 16 for 3rd order).")
151    if gain > 1.0 or gain < 0.0:
152        raise AttributeError("The gain must be in range [0., 1.].")
153
154    total_frames = ambi_file.total_frames
155    saved_position = ambi_file.get_current_position()
156    frames_written = 0
157
158    try:
159        ambi_file.reset_position()
160
161        with sf.SoundFile(
162            str(out_path),
163            mode="w",
164            samplerate=ambi_file.get_samplerate(),
165            channels=2,
166            subtype=subtype,
167            format="WAV",
168        ) as out:
169            frames_read = 0
170            while True:
171                chunk, end_of_file = ambi_file.get_next_chunk()
172                if chunk is None:
173                    # empty file: nothing was convolved, so there is no tail
174                    break
175
176                block = sh.process_ola(chunk)
177                if gain != 1.0:
178                    block = block * gain
179                out.write(block)
180                frames_written += block.shape[0]
181                frames_read += chunk.shape[0]
182
183                if progress_callback is not None:
184                    progress_callback(frames_read, total_frames)
185
186                if end_of_file:
187                    # flush the final convolution tail (matches mode='full')
188                    tail = sh.flush()
189                    if gain != 1.0:
190                        tail = tail * gain
191                    out.write(tail)
192                    frames_written += tail.shape[0]
193                    break
194    finally:
195        # rendering must not disturb the caller's read position
196        ambi_file.seek_to_position(saved_position)
197
198    return frames_written

Decode an entire AmbiX file to a binaural stereo WAV, streamed in chunks.

Memory usage is O(chunk): one FFT buffer plus one (M-1, 2) overlap buffer, independent of file length. Output length equals total_frames + sh.get_IR_length() - 1, matching a full-file mode='full' convolution (SphericalHarmonics.apply_hrtf).

Parameters
  • ambi_file (AmbisonicsFile): Input file. Its chunk size drives the streaming block length. The read position is saved on entry and restored on exit.
  • sh (SphericalHarmonics): Decoder whose channel count must match the file. Rendering uses the decoder's current rotation state; equivalence with apply_hrtf (which ignores rotation) holds only for identity rotation.
  • out_path (str or Path): Output WAV path. Overwritten if it exists.
  • gain (float, optional): Post-decode gain in [0., 1.], applied per block. Default 1.0.
  • subtype (str, optional): libsndfile subtype for the output. Default "FLOAT" (32-bit float) to preserve decode precision; note plain soundfile.write would default to "PCM_16" for WAV.
  • progress_callback (callable, optional): Called once per chunk as progress_callback(frames_read, total_frames).
Returns
  • int: Number of stereo frames written (0 for an empty input file).
Raises
  • ValueError: If the file channel count does not match the decoder.
  • AttributeError: If gain is outside [0., 1.].
